 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

**The misspelled word is 'Conveinient'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Convenient'.**
 
• The word '**Convenient**' is an **adjective** which means 'suitable or fitting for a particular purpose; easy to use or access'. **(सुविधाजनक)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• This app makes it convenient to order food online.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be **'Conveinient'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words -**

 
• **Precise -** marked by exactness and accuracy of expression or detail **(सटीक)**
 
• **Leisure -** free time when one is not working or occupied **(अवकाश)**
 
• **Harmony -** agreement or concord **(सामंजस्य)**
